cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(sam3_native LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
set(GGML_CUDA ON CACHE BOOL "CUDA backend" FORCE)
set(GGML_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GGML_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GGML_METAL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(ggml)
add_library(sam3 STATIC sam3.cpp)
target_include_directories(sam3 PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/stb)
target_compile_definitions(sam3 PRIVATE GGML_USE_CUDA)
target_link_libraries(sam3 PUBLIC ggml ggml-cuda)
target_compile_features(sam3 PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
